# Volume 5 timeline

## CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Rilla Blythe](../character/rilla-blythe.md), [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md)** — [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) approaches [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) while [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) sit on the veranda chatting after Anne's return from [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe). [Susan](../character/susan.md) watches over six-year-old [Rilla](../character/rilla-blythe.md) and baby [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) while recounting recent local gossip to [Anne](../character/anne.md), including an incident involving Mrs. Harrison Miller.

## CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN

**[Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md), [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Davis](../character/davis.md), [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md)** — Miss Cornelia and [Susan](../character/susan.md) share local gossip with [Anne](../character/anne.md) following her return from [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe), detailing the antics of the new [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) minister, Mr. Meredith, and his motherless children. They discuss the messy state of the manse, the children's mischief, and local church politics before Miss Cornelia departs.

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Rilla Blythe](../character/rilla-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and Miss Cornelia finish their conversation about their return from [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe), music lessons for the children, and local news regarding [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) and the Ford family. Miss Cornelia departs after voicing her disapproval of Owen Ford's travel plans, leaving [Anne](../character/anne.md) to sit on the veranda steps and enjoy the evening moonrise over [Four Winds Harbour](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor).

## CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN

**[Di](../character/di.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md)** — [The Blythe](../codex/factions.md#the-blythe) children gather in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), their favorite play area behind the maple grove. [Jem](../character/jem.md) cooks freshly caught trout over a campfire while the siblings chat about their surroundings, flying dreams, and their love for the place. Just as they prepare to eat their meal, an unexpected visitor arrives from the direction of the manse.

## CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE

**[Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), Merediths, [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Davis](../character/davis.md), Presbyterian, Methodist, [Taylor](../character/taylor.md), [Cecilia Meredith](../character/cecilia-meredith.md), Blythes, [Walter](../character/walter.md), [Shakespeare](../character/shakespeare.md), [Di](../character/di.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Adam](../character/adam.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md), [Kenneth](../character/kenneth.md), [Persis Ford](../character/persis-ford.md)** — [The Meredith](../codex/factions.md#the-meredith) children sit in the old [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) graveyard chatting about town gossips, buried people, and their new [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) neighbors. Drawn by a wonderful smell, they run down into [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) and join the [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) children for a meal of trout. The two groups quickly become firm friends as they share stories of their lives.

**[Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Di](../character/di.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md)** — [The Blythe](../codex/factions.md#the-blythe) and Meredith children discuss the [West](../character/west.md) sisters and Mrs. Ford while getting ready to head home from [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley). [The Blythe](../codex/factions.md#the-blythe) children return to [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), while [Jem](../character/jem.md) slips away to pick mayflowers for his mother.

## CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE

**[Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md)** — [The Meredith](../codex/factions.md#the-meredith) children find a starved runaway named [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) hiding in an old barn. After feeding her at the manse, they listen to her traumatic life story, introduce her to the [Blythes](../codex/factions.md#blythes) in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), and arrange for her to spend the night in their garret.

**[Faith](../character/faith.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Mary](../character/mary.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) arrange a bed for Mary in the garret because the spare room is torn up. Hearing Mary crying in the night, [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) goes up to comfort her, and they discuss Mary's fear of returning to Mrs. [Wiley](../character/wiley.md) before making peace and falling asleep together. Meanwhile, [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) walks the floor below, unaware of Mary's plight.

## CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE

**[Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Cecilia Meredith](../character/cecilia-meredith.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md), [Wiley](../character/wiley.md)** — [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) attends church with the manse children after borrowing a dress, making a impression with her lively behavior and strong singing voice. Afterwards, she settles into the manse, refusing to go to school but diligently cleaning and taking on house chores while clashing slightly with [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) over the cooking. She spends time playing with the Meredith and [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), fascinating and sometimes infuriating them with her stories, talents, and bold personality while secretly fearing Mrs. Wiley's eventual return.

## CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES

**[Rilla Blythe](../character/rilla-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md)** — [Rilla](../character/rilla-blythe.md) sets out to deliver a basket of strawberries to the manse, but [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) frightens her and chases her back down the street with a dried codfish. Miss Cornelia rescues the terrified and muddy child and brings her home, where she and [Anne](../character/anne.md) discuss the local children and gossip about potential wives for the minister.

## CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Di](../character/di.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), [Mary](../character/mary.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md)** — Miss Cornelia investigates Mary's past and learns that Mrs. [Wiley](../character/wiley.md) has died, leaving Mary an orphan once more. Meanwhile, the children gather in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) to hear [Walter](../character/walter.md) read myths and share stories. [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md) arrives with the news of Mrs. Wiley's death, startling Mary, while [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) promises to pray that Mary can remain in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds).

## CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE

**[Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Blythe](../character/blythe.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md)** — Miss Cornelia confronts Mr. Meredith about Mary Vance's background, prompting him to have a kind heart-to-heart conversation with Mary. Desperate to prevent Mary from being sent back to the orphan asylum, [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) plucks up the courage to ask Miss Cornelia to adopt her. After consulting her husband [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), Miss Cornelia agrees to take Mary in, and the children celebrate her new home before she leaves the manse.

**[Carl](../character/carl.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Mary](../character/mary.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Wiley](../character/wiley.md), [Wilson](../character/wilson.md)** — Mary warns [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) about the dangers of stepmothers and predicts that their father might marry again, leaving [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) deeply upset and unable to sleep. Meanwhile, [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) stays up all night reading a biography of St. Augustine and briefly reflects on his children and late wife, Cecelia.

## CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY

**[Adella](../character/adella.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Di](../character/di.md), [Elder Abraham](../character/elder-abraham.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Minnie](../character/minnie.md), [Blythe](../character/blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — While their father and [Jerry](../character/jerry.md) are away and [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) is bedridden with an illness, [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) try to manage the household and care for a sick [Carl](../character/carl.md). On Monday, they attempt to clean the house and shake rugs in the adjacent graveyard, inadvertently causing a scandal in the community when neighbors mistake their actions as occurring on Sunday. Despite running low on food and struggling with cooking, their troubles end when [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) recovers, sunshine returns, and the [Blythes](../codex/factions.md#blythes) come back to join them in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley).

## CHAPTER XII. AN EXPLANATION AND A DARE

**[Adam](../character/adam.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Baxter](../character/baxter.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Di](../character/di.md), [Elder Abraham](../character/elder-abraham.md), [Elder Clow](../character/elder-clow.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Mary](../character/mary.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md)** — Mary joins the children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) and informs [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) that they have caused a scandal by mistakenly cleaning house on Sunday. The children realize [Faith](../character/faith.md) lost track of the days because prayer meeting was moved. Afterwards, [Walter](../character/walter.md) describes his poetic vision of heaven to the group, and [Faith](../character/faith.md) assures [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) that she has a plan to clear up the town's misunderstanding.

## CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Baxter](../character/baxter.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Cooper](../character/cooper.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Davis](../character/davis.md), [Elder Clow](../character/elder-clow.md), [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Leander Crawford](../character/leander-crawford.md), [Mary](../character/mary.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [Shakespeare](../character/shakespeare.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md), [Wiley](../character/wiley.md)** — At the church service, [Faith](../character/faith.md) addresses the congregation to clear her father's name regarding the house-cleaning incident, explaining the mix-up in days. The following day, [Faith](../character/faith.md) dares [Walter](../character/walter.md) to ride pigs through the village streets, drawing various reactions from the villagers. Later, Miss Cornelia visits [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) to discuss Faith's antics with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md), leading to a lighthearted conversation about childhood and local town gossip.

## CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL

**[John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md)** — [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) encounters [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) by a hidden spring in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), where they share a drink and conversation before he carries her books home. At her house, John converses with Rosemary's sister, [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md), about world affairs and [German](../codex/factions.md#german) politics. After John leaves, [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) suggests he has romantic intentions toward [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md), though [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) dismisses the idea.

**[Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [George](../character/george.md)** — [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) and [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) discuss European politics and [German](../codex/factions.md#german) militarism before John takes his leave. Afterward, [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) warns [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) against courting or romance with the widowed minister, reminding her of a promise she made. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) is irritated by the warning and retires to her room, feeling unsettled and melancholy as autumn arrives.

## CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP

**[Adam](../character/adam.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Cecilia Meredith](../character/cecilia-meredith.md), [Davis](../character/davis.md), [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), German, [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) becomes engrossed in [German](../codex/factions.md#german) theology, forgetting his parish duties and family until the wealthy and overbearing Mrs. [Alec Davis](../character/davis.md) visits the manse. Mrs. [Davis](../character/davis.md) angrily demands to adopt [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) and accuses him of neglecting his children, but he firmly refuses and sends her away. Shaken by her accusations, Mr. Meredith reflects on his shortcomings as a father and decides to seek advice from Mrs. [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside).

**[Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Davis](../character/davis.md), [Blythe](../character/blythe.md), [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md)** — Mr. Meredith observes his children during supper and reflects on Mrs. Davis's complaints about their behavior. Seeing that Mrs. [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) is away, he decides to visit the [West](../character/west.md) homestead to return a borrowed book and enjoy the company of [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) and [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md).

## CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md), [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Di](../character/di.md)** — [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md), and [Anne](../character/anne.md) discuss the recent funeral of [Myra Murray](../character/myra-murray.md) and gossip about local church business and parish families. [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) finishes her knitting and runs down to [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), where she tells [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md) about Mrs. [Alec Davis](../character/davis.md) leaving the church and the potential loss of ministry salary. Horrified at the thought of having to move away from [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary, [Faith](../character/faith.md) decides she must act to convince [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md) to return to the congregation.

## CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY

**[Faith](../character/faith.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md), [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md), [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md), [Wilson](../character/wilson.md)** — [Faith](../character/faith.md) walks down the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) with [Walter](../character/walter.md), who suffers from a toothache and worries about his inability to confront bullies like [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md), who hurls insults at [Faith](../character/faith.md) as they pass. [Faith](../character/faith.md) then visits [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md) to persuade him to return to church and pay his salary, but she is initially intimidated and retreats after he shouts at her. Furious at his insults, [Faith](../character/faith.md) returns to confront him directly; impressed by her fiery spirit, Norman apologizes, agrees to return to church, and invites her to sit for supper.

**[Faith](../character/faith.md), [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md), [Wilson](../character/wilson.md), [Davis](../character/davis.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md)** — [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md) admires Faith's spirited confrontation and convinces her to share a meal with him. He agrees to contribute to the church salary and attend services once a month, provided [Faith](../character/faith.md) accepts his nickname 'Red Rose' for her and hears his unorthodox views. Afterwards, Norman drives [Faith](../character/faith.md) home with a buggy full of gifts, leaving her relieved that her father's position in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) is secure.

## CHAPTER XVIII. MARY BRINGS EVIL TIDINGS

**[Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Blythe](../character/blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md)** — After church, [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md) teases [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md) and challenges her father's theology. At school, [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md) insults [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md), prompting [Walter Blythe](../character/walter.md) to defend them and challenge Dan to a fight. Despite feeling nervous and apprehensive beforehand, [Walter](../character/walter.md) fiercely defeats Dan after school the next day, earning praise from Mr. Meredith and comfort from his mother.

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [Shakespeare](../character/shakespeare.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md)** — [Walter](../character/walter.md) resolves to face his fears and get his tooth pulled after talking to Mr. Douglas, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) comforts him when he returns home. Downstairs, [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), and Miss Cornelia discuss Walter's fight, as well as rumors that Mr. Meredith may be courting [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md).

## CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM!

**[Adam](../character/adam.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Blythe](../character/blythe.md), [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md), [Perry](../character/perry.md), [Di](../character/di.md), [Taylor](../character/taylor.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Wilson](../character/wilson.md)** — [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) meets [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md), and [Di](../character/di.md) in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) while on her way to [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), proudly showing off her new winter clothes. [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) feels envious and self-conscious about her shabby garments, but eventually softens toward Mary after a tense interaction. When Mary mentions that [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) killed a rooster for dinner, [Faith](../character/faith.md) panics and races home to save her pet rooster, [Adam](../character/adam.md).

## CHAPTER XX. FAITH MAKES A FRIEND

**[Adam](../character/adam.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Perry](../character/perry.md), [Rilla Blythe](../character/rilla-blythe.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — [Faith](../character/faith.md) is furious with [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) for killing her rooster, [Adam](../character/adam.md), to feed a visiting minister, Mr. [Perry](../character/perry.md). During Sunday dinner, [Faith](../character/faith.md) fumes as Mr. [Perry](../character/perry.md) eats [Adam](../character/adam.md) and patronizes the family. Later in the study, [Faith](../character/faith.md) watches silently as Mr. Perry's coat-tails catch fire from the hearth, cheekily claiming she did not want to interrupt him.

## CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD

**[Faith](../character/faith.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — [Faith](../character/faith.md), distraught over the mocking she received at school regarding [Adam](../character/adam.md), seeks out Mrs. [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) but instead encounters [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley). [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) listens sympathetically, comforts [Faith](../character/faith.md), and offers to give her a canary. Later at home, [Faith](../character/faith.md) tells her family how much she loves [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md), catching her father's interest.

## CHAPTER XXII. ST. GEORGE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT

**[John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md), [Emmeline Drew](../character/emmeline-drew.md), [Elizabeth Kirk](../character/elizabeth-kirk.md), [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md)** — [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) walks through [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) toward the [West](../character/west.md) home, reflecting on how he has grown to love [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) and resolved to propose to her. He reflects on his past widowhood, community expectations, and his genuine fondness for both sisters, knowing [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) will be away for the evening. Meanwhile, [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) dreads his arrival, bound by a solemn childhood promise made over her mother's Bible to [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) never to marry.

**[Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md)** — [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) recalls the solemn vow she and [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) made ten years ago to never marry, which now prevents her from accepting [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md). When John unexpectedly proposes, [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) finds herself unable to give him a direct refusal because she realizes she loves him. Instead, she asks for a few days to consider his proposal, leaving John disappointed and confused as he departs.

## CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB

**[Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md), [Cecilia Meredith](../character/cecilia-meredith.md)** — [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) returns home from a party feeling content after winning a friendly debate with [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md). When she arrives, [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) reveals that Mr. Meredith proposed to her, but [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) strictly refuses to release [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) from her vow not to marry, despite Rosemary's pleas. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) subsequently writes a cold refusal letter to [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), leaving both Meredith and [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) heartbroken while [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) tries to justify keeping her sister to herself.

## CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE

**[Faith](../character/faith.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md)** — [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) visits the manse children in the graveyard to lecture them on their misbehaviour and gossip about their father's potential romance with [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md). After Mary leaves, [Jem Blythe](../character/jem.md) arrives and suggests that the children form a self-policing Good-[Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#conduct-club). Inspired by the idea, the four children agree to start the club to avoid causing further trouble for their father.

**[Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), Methodist, [Elder Clow](../character/elder-clow.md), Glen, [West](../character/west.md), [Adam](../character/adam.md)** — [The Meredith](../codex/factions.md#the-meredith) children finalize the rules for their new Good-[Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#conduct-club), agreeing to hold themselves accountable and punish bad behavior to protect their father's reputation. After signing the club's document in the graveyard, [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) expresses her fear to [Faith](../character/faith.md) that their father might marry Miss [West](../character/west.md) and become a stepmother, influenced by Mary Vance's horror stories.

## CHAPTER XXV. ANOTHER SCANDAL AND ANOTHER “EXPLANATION”

**[Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Henry Warren](../character/henry-warren.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Lida Marsh](../character/lida-marsh.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — [Faith](../character/faith.md) gives her shoes and last pair of nice stockings to a impoverished girl named [Lida Marsh](../character/lida-marsh.md). Upon realizing she will be forced to wear hideous striped stockings to church, [Faith](../character/faith.md) deliberately stands on an ice bank in the graveyard to make herself sick. [Jerry](../character/jerry.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) forcibly pull her off the snow before they all go inside to bed.

## CHAPTER XXVI. MISS CORNELIA GETS A NEW POINT OF VIEW

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), Conduct Club, [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Di](../character/di.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Lida Marsh](../character/lida-marsh.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md)** — [Faith](../character/faith.md) causes a scandal at church by attending without stockings, which leads to gossip across the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) and discussions among [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), and Miss Cornelia. In [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md) and [Di](../character/di.md) defend [Faith](../character/faith.md) when [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) criticizes her, but [Jerry](../character/jerry.md) and the [Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#conduct-club) decide to punish [Faith](../character/faith.md) by making her wear her hated striped stockings. To clear her father's name and clarify other misunderstandings, [Faith](../character/faith.md) writes and publishes a detailed letter of explanation in the local newspaper.

## CHAPTER XXVII. A SACRED CONCERT

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Blythe](../character/blythe.md), [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md)** — [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) Elliott arrives at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) distraught over a controversial letter published in the local paper, prompting gossip about local church members and the manse children. [Anne](../character/anne.md) passionately defends Mr. Meredith and his children, convincing [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) to shift her attitude from apologizing for them to celebrating their unique strengths.

## CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Baxter](../character/baxter.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md)** — [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) complain to [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) about the minister's children singing a lighthearted song in the graveyard during a [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) prayer meeting. After [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) brings the issue to Mr. Meredith's attention, he calls [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), and [Carl](../character/carl.md) into his study to gently reprimand them. Ashamed, the children resolve to punish themselves through their [Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#conduct-club), while Mr. Meredith despairs over his parenting and longs for [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md).

## CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE

**[Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Elder Clow](../character/elder-clow.md), [Elizabeth Kirk](../character/elizabeth-kirk.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — [The Meredith](../codex/factions.md#the-meredith) children decide to fast all day Sunday as a self-imposed punishment for their Good-[Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#conduct-club), but [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) faints during the evening church service from lack of food. Doctor [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) revives [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), and [Faith](../character/faith.md) explains to her father and Mrs. Clow that the children are raising themselves. Distressed by Faith's words, [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) resolves to be a better father to his children, though he realizes he can never marry anyone but [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md).

## CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE

**Bailey, [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Di](../character/di.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Henry Warren](../character/henry-warren.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Taylor](../character/taylor.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md)** — The children gather in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) to read poems and discuss their future dreams of traveling the world when they grow up. Their tranquil evening is interrupted when [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) arrives and frightens them with the tragic tale of [Henry](../character/henry.md) Warren's ghost haunting the nearby [Bailey](../codex/places.md#bailey) garden. After cooking and eating Jerry's fresh-caught trout, the children disperse for the night, with [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), and [Carl](../character/carl.md) nervously avoiding the old garden on their walk home.

## CHAPTER XXXI. CARL DOES PENANCE

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Di](../character/di.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Kenneth](../character/kenneth.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Persis Ford](../character/persis-ford.md), [Rilla Blythe](../character/rilla-blythe.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Stimson](../character/stimson.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md)** — [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) become terrified in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) when they mistake Mrs. [Stimson](../character/stimson.md)—who is crawling on the [Bailey](../codex/places.md#bailey) garden dyke with white sheets on her shoulders looking for a knitting needle—for the ghost of [Henry Warren](../character/henry-warren.md). Terrified, the Meredith children sprint to [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), where [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) and [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) soothe them. [Susan](../character/susan.md) investigates with a pitchfork and returns to explain the embarrassing truth, prompting the children to retreat home in shame.

## CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE

**[Alec](../character/alec.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Henry Warren](../character/henry-warren.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — [Jerry](../character/jerry.md) decrees punishments for the children's cowardice, sending [Carl](../character/carl.md) to sit in the graveyard until midnight. [Carl](../character/carl.md) bravely endures the cold, rainy vigil, but falls dangerously ill with double pneumonia as a result. After a grim fight for his life, [Carl](../character/carl.md) recovers with the support of the family and community, and the children celebrate his return to health.

## CHAPTER XXXIII. CARL IS—NOT—WHIPPED

**[Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md), [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md), [George](../character/george.md), Germany** — [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md) confronts [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) at the spring in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), asking her to release [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) from her past vow so they can marry, to which [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) agrees. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) returns home and informs [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) of the encounter, releasing her from the promise. However, [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) refuses to marry Norman if [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) remains living alone on the hill, leaving their future uncertain.

## CHAPTER XXXIV. UNA VISITS THE HILL

**[Carl](../character/carl.md), [Carr](../character/carr.md), [Davis](../character/davis.md), [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md), [Emmeline Drew](../character/emmeline-drew.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) gossips with [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) about local rumors, including [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) West's refusal to marry their father and Carl's prank involving an eel and Mrs. [Carr](../character/carr.md). After Mr. Meredith hears about the prank, he confronts [Carl](../character/carl.md) and intends to whip him, but finds himself unable to go through with the punishment when he looks into Carl's eyes. [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) later witnesses her father's deep anguish alone in his dark study.

## CHAPTER XXXV. “LET THE PIPER COME”

**[Adam](../character/adam.md), [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md), Blythes, [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md), [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md)** — Determined to make her unhappy father happy, [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) visits her late mother's gray dress in the spare room before walking to the [West](../character/west.md) house to speak with [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md). Thinking stepmothers are cruel, [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) selflessly begs [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) to marry her father and promises that the children will behave. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) reassures [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), writes a letter agreeing to meet [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), and sends [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) back to the manse to deliver it.

## Chapter 37

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md), [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Di](../character/di.md), [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md), Miss Cornelia, and [Susan](../character/susan.md) discuss the upcoming double wedding of [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) and Mr. Meredith, alongside [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md) and [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md). Meanwhile, the children gather in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) to celebrate Jem's final evening before he leaves for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown). [Walter](../character/walter.md) poetically describes the Pied Piper calling them, and [Jem](../character/jem.md) eagerly responds that he would follow the Piper anywhere.
